Ritual of BraveryActive
Increases all allies' ATK by 40% for 2 turns and grants them [Attacking Stance I] for 2 turns.
Encouraging PosturePassiveExclusive Lv.2
At the beginning of Winona's turn, restores all allies' HP by 3.6% of Max HP, and restores 100 Stance value for anyone under [Parry] status and has the lowest Stance value.
Flame Tambourine Lv.2Encouraging Posture: Additionally restores 30 Stance value for anyone under [Parry] status. Winona has extra 18% Healing Effect.
